basics.name: Anushree Ganta
basics.label: Frontend Developer
basics.summary: Frontend Developer with technical expertise in designing, developing, and optimizing high-performance web applications. Skilled in modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems, HTML5/CSS3, React, state management frameworks, UI component architecture, and REST/GraphQL API integration. Passionate about building responsive, accessible, and user-centric web applications with emphasis on web performance, cross-browser compatibility, and modern design systems.

work.name: Walmart
work.summary: Lead architectural strategy for core backend microservices and high-throughput data synchronization pipelines powering search ranking, faceted navigation, and merchandising rules for 8 Global Markets, directly optimizing search relevance to drive conversion velocity and global business revenue.
highlights: Engineered an automated Facet Lifecycle Management backend utilizing a custom State Machine; managed 82,000+ business curations backed by CosmosDB and Elasticsearch with self-healing distributed reconciliation.

Designed a high-scale analytics pipeline integrating Azure Synapse Analytics and Control-M to ingest and analyze 500M+ monthly user interaction logs, translating telemetry into real-time merchandising adjustments.

Designed a resilient Spark Streaming and Kafka pipeline for near-real-time synchronization, implementing idempotent processing and Cassandra TTL contracts to eliminate race conditions across 100M+ catalog items.

Spearheaded performance tuning, JVM optimization (G1GC, connection pool sizing), and tech modernization of core Java microservices; standardized Kubernetes resource scaling to improve system throughput by 20%.

Architected a zero-downtime data layer migration for the Item-Pinning microservice, designing tenant-aware DAOs with dual-write synchronization across AzureSQL and GCP PostgreSQL to onboard 5 global markets with zero service interruption.

work.name: Walmart

Architected event-driven A/B testing and interleaving experiment infrastructure, utilizing Kafka to broadcast rule updates and implementing safety gates to prevent rule collision in production.
Deconstructed a legacy monolithic application into independent Java microservices, extracting the Category Intervention service to isolate CPU resources and double deployment velocity.
Designed and deployed a Spark Streaming data pipeline to synchronize product catalog updates with Elasticsearch and Cassandra, reducing cache synchronization lag from 4 hours to under 30 seconds.
Engineered a versioned NoSQL data model for the core Rules Engine, replacing relational tables with CosmosDB schemas and executing a zero-downtime, 4-phase migration of 58,000+ business rules.
Led zero-downtime migrations from AzureSQL to GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), establishing distributed cache clusters and optimizing index strategies to support 15,000+ QPS.

key_differentiators.summary: Why hire me as a Frontend Developer

points.detail: I design and build intuitive, scalable, and modular web applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks. By leveraging component-driven architecture and design systems, I deliver maintainable frontend code bases.

I specialize in optimizing web applications for fast load times, smooth interactions, and accessibility. By tuning bundle sizes, rendering paths, and Core Web Vitals, I ensure exceptional user experiences.
I bridge frontend user interfaces with complex backend ecosystems, engineering robust client-side state management, async data fetching, and real-time UI updates.
